## Use this when

- research this land or water question
- investigate this agriculture signal
- give me an evidence brief on this region
- validate this environmental signal
- do a resilience investigation

## Problem

A buyer has one bounded agriculture, land, water, production or resilience question and needs a sourced evidence-first investigation.

## Inputs

Defined question, buyer email and selected fixed offer. Geography, organization and use case are optional scope context.

## Outputs

A bounded evidence-first mission packet with findings, source references, uncertainty/evidence-needed items, challenge notes and human-review items.

## Pricing

Signal Brief $250 one-time; Proof Sprint $2,500 one-time. Other intake categories are not auto-quotable.

- FAIE Signal Brief: $250 (one_time)

- FAIE Proof Sprint: $2,500 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: FAIE HTTP agent gateway + OpenAPI + llms guidance + remote MCP at https://faie.base44.app/functions/faieMcp. Agents can inspect the fixed $250/$2,500 offers, prepare checkout only after explicit human confirmation, and verify payment/mission queue state. Paid work remains human-review controlled.

Explicit buyer confirmation is required before checkout. Verified payment queues a human-controlled mission; consequential claims or actions remain review-gated.

Payment authority: FAIE / Stripe, provider-verified

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
